objective: derive finite two-port safe-closing certificates from robust nominal connector words on a compact registered public source set

requirements.plant: registered metric plant with finite connector words, state and disturbance Lipschitz bounds, and strict evaluator-safe and reset margins
requirements.public_state: sensor cell labels determine charged public reachable sets and all reset-relevant memories
requirements.compactness: the robust source basins cover a compact registered recurrent component
requirements.ports: sensor labels and actuator words are separately charged
requirements.execution: the actuator dictionary includes word duration and resets every registered private memory

scope_boundary: this theorem does not prove robust pointwise connectors for every canonical normally hyperbolic class, and a fixed-reset atlas does not by itself satisfy the stronger all-pairs local premise of v0.34
